label: copy phase: input p about to output d (p->d bigram recall), late recall positions
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never original or delimiter steps), only at recall_idx >= 3, and 96% of activation mass is on steps whose input is p (rest on input d, mostly in d-d repeats). Strongest when the original sequence contained the bigram p d, so the model inputs p and must output d (rate ~48% vs ~3% for any copy-phase p; 74% coverage of the top activation quartile). Weaker, low-magnitude activations occur on copy-phase p followed by other tokens. Magnitude grows with recall position/sequence length (L=9 holds 54% of mass; recall_idx 8 has highest rate). Does not fire on p in the original phase, or at recall_idx < 3 (e.g. short sequences like t u p d). Dev: P=0.76, R=0.42, mass recall 0.62; broad p-in-copy predicate gets 0.96 mass recall but 3-5% precision.
